{{Quote|Thank you for seeing us on such short notice.''"<br />"''The king and queen of Cortella are always welcome.|Obi-Wan Kenobi and the president of the Leadership School|<ref name="School" />}}
'''Cortella''' was a [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] ruled by a [[Monarchy/Legends|monarchy]]. In [[25 BBY/Legends|25 BBY]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Siri Tachi/Legends|Siri Tachi]] impersonated the [[King/Legends|king]] and [[Queen/Legends|queen]] of Cortella in order to [[Mission to Andara|infiltrate]] the elite [[Leadership School]] on the planet [[Andara/Legends|Andara]]. During a meeting with the school's [[Unidentified Leadership School president|president]], in which they negotiated a permission to carry out a tour of the establishment, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] pretended to be interested in sending their [[Gender/Legends|son]] to attend the school.

==Description==
Cortella was a little-known [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|145|Cortella}}</ref> located in the [[Cortella system/Legends|Cortella system]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="TEA Cortella" />

==History==
{{Quote|If you ever get tired of being a Jedi, you'd make an amazing queen.''"<br />"''And you'd make a terrible king. Royal regal sons?''"<br />"''I was trying to sound pompous.|Obi-Wan Kenobi and Siri Tachi|<ref name="School" />}}
[[File:TachiOlinKenobi-TheSchoolOfFearJapanese.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Siri Tachi (left) and Obi-Wan Kenobi (right) impersonated the queen and king of Cortella while infiltrating the Leadership School on Andara.]]
Cortella was ruled by a [[Monarchy/Legends|monarchy]].<ref name="CSWE" /> In [[25 BBY/Legends|25 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> while [[Mission to Andara|investigating]] the elite [[Leadership School]] on<ref name="School" /> the Core Worlds<ref name="TEA Andara">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Andaran system]]</ref> planet [[Andara/Legends|Andara]],<ref name="School" /> the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]]<ref name="TERC" /> [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Siri Tachi/Legends|Siri Tachi]] realized they needed a suitable cover for infiltrating the establishment. To that end, Kenobi came up with a plan for them to impersonate the [[King/Legends|king]] and [[Queen/Legends|queen]] of Cortella in order to be able to go on a tour of the school.<ref name="School" />

After contacting within [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]] Kenobi's acquaintance, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Senatorial aide]] [[Tyro Caladian]], to help rapidly procure false identity documents, the two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] met with the [[Unidentified Leadership School president|president]] of the Leadership School, having contacted him under the pretense of considering the school for their supposed [[Gender/Legends|son]], a [[Prince/Legends|prince]]. During the meeting, the Jedi wore traveler's [[Clothing/Legends|tunics]], which the pair rationalized as being intentionally inconspicuous. Tachi had not changed her appearance significantly, having only slicked her [[Hair/Legends|hair]] back more, and Kenobi attempted to affect a pompous manner of speech. During the conversation with the [[President/Legends|president]]&mdash;who considered the interest by the monarchs of Cortella an honor&mdash;the Jedi claimed they were alternatively considering a school on<ref name="School" /> the Core Worlds planet<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] and eventually negotiated a permission to carry out an unguided tour of the Leadership School.<ref name="School" />

==Behind the scenes==
Cortella was first mentioned in [[Jedi Quest: The School of Fear|''The School of Fear'']], [[Jude Watson]]'s [[2003]] fifth installment of the ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Quest]]'' young-reader novel series.<ref name="School" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Cortella [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the planet itself, in grid square K-9.<ref name="TEA Cortella" />
